summary: AI agents are only as powerful as the data they can reach. Most MCP tools connect to the easy data. But enterprise value lives in spatial, CAD, BIM, legacy databases, and real-time feeds — systems that will never have a native MCP interface. FME gives organizations an All Data MCP Server: any workflow becomes an MCP tool, on any data, available to any AI. 500+ systems. Thousands of possible tools. Cloud and on-premises. No exceptions.
